answer: Use sealed clock attestation: each identity must submit a timed pulse from a tamper-evident module, and repeated timing signatures are rejected. The module’s crystal drift is measured at issue against public beacons, so clones produce detectable anomalies. Registration therefore consumes one walnut-sized sealed unit per identity. An attacker’s per-identity cost becomes separate hardware plus physical hosting and clock-sync upkeep, which blocks bulk sybils.
